verdict.rationale: Docs clearly describe custodial accounts that auto-credit and hold stablecoin balances (deposit destinations, treasury features, auto-liquidation) via coinbase-payments-docs-1, -19, -20, -22, showing this is a real, documented capability. However, the evidence never states supported geographies, KYC/eligibility gating, or account availability limits that a finance lead would need to assess usability in their jurisdiction. Missing for 10: documented supported countries/regions, KYC/onboarding requirements, and any stated balance/limits or gating disclosures.
